title: How Far Can Fairness Constraints Help Recover From Biased Data?
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is a theoretical work on algorithmic fairness and does not conduct any benchmarks related to religion or faith.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. It is a theoretical study of recovering accurate and fair classifiers from biased data using mathematical models and fairness constraints.
